chunks: About a captive whom the polytheists capture, then the time of salat (prayer) comes upon him, and the one who captured him prevents him from it; he said: "He should gesture, gesturing."

key_terms.إِيمَاءً: gesturing, meaning symbolic bodily indication for the prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the obligatory salat (prayer) whose time has arrived
key_terms.الْأَسِيرِ: the captive or prisoner being held
key_terms.يُومِئُ: he indicates or gestures in place of normal physical actions

ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim captive pray if prevented by the polytheists from performing salat (prayer) normally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a captive who is prevented from performing salat (prayer) in its normal form. In such a case, he performs it by gesture, showing that salat (prayer) is not dropped even under coercive circumstances.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.745 - Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Him

about a captive taken by the polytheists who is prevented from performing prayer by his captor.
Imam (as) said: "He should make gestures (for prayer)."
